recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片有大型、核呈單一圓形不分葉的巨核細胞（monolobated megakaryocyte），切片也可見低分葉巨核細胞增加，紅血球系有核間橋接（紅箭頭）；核型第 5 號染色體長臂缺失（紅箭頭），符合 MDS 合併單獨 del(5q)。
features: Aspirate: large megakaryocyte with a single round non-lobated nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm
Aspirate: dysplastic erythroid precursors including internuclear bridging (red arrow) and nuclear budding
Biopsy (H&E): normocellular to hypercellular marrow with increased small monolobated/hypolobated megakaryocytes
Karyotype with interstitial deletion of the long arm of chromosome 5 (red arrow)
describe_en: Composite figure. The bone marrow aspirate shows megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated (monolobated) nuclei, and dysplastic erythroid precursors including an internuclear chromatin bridge. The core biopsy shows increased hypolobated and monolobated megakaryocytes without erythroid hypoplasia. Karyotype demonstrates an interstitial deletion of 5q (46,XX,del(5)(q15q35)[9]/46,XX[1]). Findings are consistent with myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q), with erythroid dysplasia including internuclear bridging.

ddx.dx: MDS with multilineage dysplasia with del(5q) plus -7/del(7q)
ddx.vs: Presence of -7/del(7q) or more than one additional abnormality excludes the del(5q) category, which requires karyotype rather than morphology.
MPN megakaryocytes are large and hyperlobated (staghorn) with no erythroid dysplasia, whereas these are monolobated.
CDA shows internuclear bridging but lacks monolobated megakaryocytes and del(5q).
